basic_profile.bio: A 25-year-old lifelong Knicks fan from Albany, NY. Recently started exploring Reddit to connect with fellow sports enthusiasts and to dive deeper into basketball discussions. Works as a graphic designer and enjoys watching movies and animated series in spare time. Single, and usually online during evenings and weekends. Loves Disney movies and has a growing interest in animated storytelling.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Grew up playing basketball and followed the NBA, especially the Knicks, since childhood. Self-taught in graphic design, which complements their interest in visually engaging content. Recently started exploring animated storytelling through watching series like 'Vivy' and 'Star Wars Rebels'.
